summary: First dependency-ordered slice of the web-shell/web-framework integration: packages/web-framework (one-writer RoomClient, named hooks, pure projection, typed EnvironmentPort), registered in scripts/boundary-policy.ts's owner table, with a narrow renderer-footgun exemption for its own raw React effects and positive/negative test coverage for that exemption. apps/web is not wired to it yet; that is the next slice, preserved on fm/agora-web-shell-integrate-checkpoint-1 and its source refs fm/agora-local-room-web-shell and fm/agora-web-framework-client-host.
